shape: a specific, lasting good thing a lucky person has, then a two- or three-word verdict

slides.text: an old roommate who still remembers the exact angle you had to hold the key in your first door. [[that is wealth]].

caption:
we shared a fridge that buzzed too loud and a hallway that always smelled like toast.
some people only belong to one specific flat, but i am glad you stayed.
send this to the old roommate who survived that first drafty kitchen with you.
alt: a small green donkey holding up a single small key, looking at it thoughtfully, with the text: an old roommate who still remembers the exact angle you had to hold the key in your first door. that is wealth.

still knowing the exact trick to the lock on the first apartment you shared.
having someone who still remembers which way to kick the kitchen radiator to make it stop buzzing.
